purpose: Human-readable execution status board after Claude/Cursor/Codex same-scenario dual-path joins; documentation/status evidence only.

evidence_scope.execution_state_note: Full execution-state read attempt timed out and was not used as evidence for this board.

groups.name: Host dual-path scenario coverage for Claude/Cursor/Codex
groups.solves: Links one same-scenario Path A adapter/API/core evidence route and one Path B host/UI-visible route or response capture for each of Claude, Cursor, and Codex.
groups.next_bounded_action: Parent review of this board and join packets; then separately authorized commit/push. Future workers must expand coverage without converting this narrow join into full readiness.

groups.name: Token savings before/after
groups.solves: Proves paired baseline/adaptive token reduction without quality regression.
current_evidence: The read join packets explicitly list token savings as not proven.
The plan requires same prompts, hashes, hosts, methods, tokenizer/accounting version, traces, token counts, variance handling, and quality non-regression.
groups.next_bounded_action: TOKEN worker for one approved scenario set with paired baseline/adaptive traces, hashes, tokenizer/accounting version, token counts, variance handling, and quality gate link.

groups.name: Quality improvement / semantic quality gates
groups.solves: Proves semantic non-regression or improvement for the adaptive/local behavior.
current_evidence: The read join packets explicitly list semantic quality as not proven.
The plan requires rubric, held-out prompts, source-disjoint split, paired scoring, reviewer notes, regression guard, layer scores, ablation, no-leakage, and no-memorization controls.
groups.next_bounded_action: QUALITY worker with rubric plus held-out paired eval for the approved scenario scope, followed by independent scoring/leakage review.

groups.name: Learnability/training/DPO and local model update
groups.solves: Proves user-local/source-grounded learning and local model update through approved material only.
current_evidence: The read join packets explicitly list learnability, training, and DPO as not proven.
The plan forbids raw external AI output as training target unless provider/license/source approval and consent/training-use approval exist.
groups.next_bounded_action: LEARN worker to prepare approved DPO candidates with provenance/license/privacy fields; training/fresh-load/eval only after source/material gate.

groups.name: Backup/export/import/share/continue-training lifecycle
groups.solves: Proves the user-local learning lifecycle can be backed up, exported, imported, restored, shared in redacted form, and continued safely.
current_evidence: The read join packets contain no lifecycle proof.
The plan says scoped lifecycle evidence must be tied to named host/machine/checkpoint gates and is not a global claim by itself.
groups.next_bounded_action: LIFECYCLE worker for one named local checkpoint and machine, with backup/export/import/restore/share/continue-training evidence, redaction, and rollback refs.

groups.name: Checkpoint mutation/promotion/locator update
groups.solves: Proves a candidate checkpoint can be safely mutated, promoted, rolled back, and referenced by the correct locator.
current_evidence: The read join packets explicitly list checkpoint mutation, checkpoint promotion, and locator update as not proven.
The plan requires exact target, rollback, held-out, ablation, promotion, and locator packets.
groups.next_bounded_action: CHECKPOINT worker only after quality/learning gates pass; name base, candidate, target, rollback refs, locator file, and promotion criteria before mutation.

groups.name: Documentation/dashboard/API evidence
groups.solves: Makes evidence visible and reviewable without converting docs/API/dashboard support evidence into product readiness.
current_evidence: The join packets document adapter/API/core boundary references for Path A.
The plan warns dashboard/API/helper pass cannot prove host readiness, token savings, quality, learning, promotion, or rollback.
not_proven: API behavior pass for all required routes
docs tied to every lifecycle and checkpoint gate
groups.next_bounded_action: DOCS-DASHBOARD-API worker: readable docs QA packet plus dashboard/API behavior packet with explicit non-claims and redaction.

groups.name: Final review cycles and skill/governance repair loops
groups.solves: Prevents false completion through independent review/evidence loops and no-overclaim governance.
current_evidence: The plan requires at least 10 dual-path scenario coverage checks after execution.
The plan says plan-review/governance rows are plan-quality evidence, not product proof.
This status board is not a final review cycle.
groups.next_bounded_action: After groups 2-7 have evidence packets, run final independent review workers over host dual-path, token, quality, learnability, lifecycle, checkpoint, docs/API/dashboard, and governance no-overclaim.

narrow_claim: Claude, Cursor, and Codex each have one narrow same-scenario dual-path join packet, and this board records which major requirement groups remain unproven.
